Hi,

Claire here, from Nora Lanelle. This was not your first order with us, and it shipped about three weeks ago. You know the fit by now, so I will skip the sizing notes this time.

One thing instead: my direct line. Anything about this order or the next, a size that is not on the page, a piece you cannot find, write to support@nora-lanelle.com with your order number in the subject. You get an answer within one to two business days.

Nothing to buy in this note. Thirty days at home and easy returns stand on this order as they did on the first.

Take care,
Claire
Nora Lanelle

subject: Last one from us.
preview: One click keeps the notes coming. No click, and we stop in 7 days. Nothing to buy.
text:
Hi,

Claire here, from Nora Lanelle. Two weeks ago I asked whether we should keep writing, and said we would stop in 14 days without a click. No click came, which is an answer; so this is the last note, one more week, unless you say otherwise.

I am staying
https://nora-lanelle.com/?stay=1

One click and nothing changes: new pieces before they reach the site, and a note on what goes with what. No click, and we stop in 7 days. The shop stays open, your account stays as it is, and you can sign up again any time.

No drama on our side. Mail should land with the women who read it, and I'd rather ask twice than assume once.

Take care,
Claire
Nora Lanelle
why: Richter: B-Basis. A sagt „a week ago“ — der Baum (§3) setzt sunset-2 auf Tag 14, B's „two weeks ago“ stimmt. Neu: die 14-Tage-Zusage aus sunset Mail 1 wird benannt und mit einer Woche Nachfrist eingelöst (S9 Tag 21), sonst widerspräche Mail 2 Mail 1. Ein Knopf ?stay=1, kein Verkauf, kein Rabatt. Varianten B/C aus A (knapp/nutzen), auf 7 Tage abgestimmt.
